target_customer: Health insurers and utilization management teams that process treatment prior authorizations
problem: Prior authorization reviewers must read long, messy medical records of 70 pages or more to decide eligibility, which is slow and costly.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to health plans, priced per organization
product_category: AI prior authorization and clinical document review

founders.name: Moses Im
education: Thomas Jefferson Medical School, MD candidate
founders.background_notes: Researched patient outcomes of surgical versus transcatheter aortic valve replacement.

founders.name: Joseph Chen
founders.background_notes: Built a prescription safety checking service at PillPack. One source lists his title as chief procurement officer.

founders.name: Grace Wang
founders.background_notes: Worked on authentication at Asana, IoT monitoring at AWS and patient data analytics at MDClone.

competitors.name: Basys.ai
competitors.what: AI prior authorization startup working with payers, backed by Mayo Clinic data

technical_complexity.rationale: Applying LLMs to long, messy medical records with accurate eligibility decisions needed careful prompting, evaluation and security, which is standard engineering with some hard parts for three founders in early 2023.

defensibility.rationale: LLM document review was replicable by other startups and incumbents, and health plan integrations gave only modest lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions acquired the company in May 2024. Other prior authorization AI companies were also bought by revenue cycle players in the period.

market_need_then: Prior authorization was a widely cited administrative burden and large language models in early 2023 made reading long clinical documents newly feasible.

branding.domain_note: Used fairwayhealth.co rather than a .com. Crunchbase lists the legal name as SpeakMosaic, Inc., unconfirmed.

identity.logo: Fairway Health logo in the site header and footer

brand_strength.rationale: Searches found no press, founder interview or community material about the brand, and the name is shared with other health businesses.

outcome_analysis: Fairway Health was a three person YC company applying LLMs to prior authorization, and it sold to TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions in May 2024, about a year after its batch. The company had no sourced venture round beyond YC's standard deal, and terms were not disclosed, so the exit looks like a small strategic acquisition of the product and team.
notes: Aggregators list a $500K pre-seed in April 2023 with Y Combinator and Unnoted Ventures, which matches YC's standard deal, so no round is recorded. The company site now shows the TurningPoint acquisition notice. The Basys.ai competitor source is dated August 2023, some months after the batch. Founding year is 2022 per YC while CB Insights gives 2019. Chen's title varies across sources.
